fields.label: literal source LUT label
fields.n_voxels: nonnegativeinteger for this participant's native BOLD grid
fields.support_sha256: SHA256 of ascending C-flat support indices serialized as little-endian int64 bytes; empty support hashes the empty byte string

arrays.source_positions: integer[20], positions in frozen loader order
arrays.raw_sample_sd: float[20,400], original rawmeans centered ddof1 scale, NaN only at absent geometry
arrays.clean_centered_l2: float[20,2,400], accurately centered norm, NaN only at absent geometry
arrays.activity_threshold: float[20,400], 1e-12*sqrt(168)*max(1,raw_sample_sd), NaN only at absent geometry
arrays.embedding_ids: U[24], subject:<literalID> for20 followed configuration:<ID> for4, key order may vary coherently
arrays.operator_valid: bool[24], complete400 source FC and finite positive-degree operator available
arrays.gpa_reference_history: float[I+1,400,10] when GPA defined; shape[0,400,10] if unavailable
arrays.display_signs: integer[5,10], +/-1 on defined coordinates,0 if undefined
arrays.pair_participant_ids: U[190,2], every unordered source pair exactlyonce

gradient_arrays_npz.axis_semantics: Every key family complete, unique and coherently reorderable; arbitrary row/column order is not a grading signal. Eigen component columns remain ordered1..10; iteration IDs chronological0..I. Reconstruct frozen subject order before all reductions.
gradient_arrays_npz.undefined: Raw means, scale/norm/threshold and cleaned vectors NaN only at false geometry; FC NaN iff either parcel inactive. Eigenvalues and eigenvectors are finite iff operator_valid, including multiscale_singular; all11 eigenvalues/all U NaN otherwise. raw_diffusion is allNaN iff embedding_valid false. principal_valid false alone does not invalidate the retained eigenbasis/G. retained_span_valid false alone retains eigenbasis/G but disables GPA. Undefined GPA has I=0, empty rotations/history/distances and allNaN aligned_gradients. Display/pair entries are NaN iff corresponding maskfalse, signs0 iff displayinvalid. All other required/extra numeric values finite; no pickle/object arrays.
gradient_arrays_npz.receipts: Canonical source inputs govern masks/operator. A source-close rounded receipt does not create new signal or move spectral cutoff. Coordinates from accepted valid U/canonical lambda/certified rotations drive reports.

fields.n_subjects_defined: integer0..expected: for a configuration, contributors with all400 source-active parcels in its arm; for aligned_mean, available final aligned subjects(20 if GPA defined,0 otherwise)

required.aligned_mean_summary: {quantity:aligned_mean,status,n_subjects_expected:20,n_subjects_defined:0or20,apex_network,bottom_network,between_within,between_within_status,principal_gap,retained_boundary_gap}; status follows configurations.csv, gaps refer to nobp_all reference
required.claim_scope: nonempty descriptive string; no verbatim prose gate

required.numerical_method_amendments: symmetric diffusion operator; largest-algebraic nontrivial modes instead of largest magnitude; exact40 signedrowretention; explicit float64 source means; public raw-scale nuisance-residual activity guard
required.warnings: all actual numerical warnings, empty list allowed; no expected-direction warning policy

source_observed_fields.headers: Each ID -> {shape,affine,source_dtype,spatial_units,temporal_units,raw_TR,raw_toffset,effective_scaling_slope,effective_scaling_intercept}. Dtype uses endian-aware NumPy dtype.str; semantically identical dtype aliases allowed.
source_observed_fields.confound_column_names: Each ID -> original source TSV header order

run_metadata_json.extras: Finite well-typed descriptive fields allowed but not new scientific authority.

findings_md: Nonempty free prose reporting measured quantities/undefined support and limits; no phrase, sign, apex, stability or difficulty grading.

serialization.csv: UTF8/BOM accepted; arbitrary row/column order, complete keyedmembership, extra harmless finite columns allowed; undefined required numeric cells empty
serialization.json: Finite standard JSON, no duplicatekeys; null only for explicitundefined; numeric fields require JSONnumbers notBoolean/numericstrings; extra finite descriptivefields allowed
serialization.npz: allow_pickleFalse; numeric integer axes value-based exactintegralnonBoolean; masksactualBoolean; stringaxesUnicode/UTF8bytes; arraysreorder coherently; declaredNaNs only
serialization.source_proof: No alternate submittedbank/sourcepin/hiddenreference path is authority.

natural_domains: All norms/degrees/counts/SSE-like distances nonnegative; eigenvalues in[-1,1] up to public eigenvalue uncertainty; reportedcorrelations [-1,1] plus scalar serialization envelope; no outcome-dependent lower bound.
failure: failure_report.json presence disqualifies complete grading; resource_pilot never qualifies; nonfinite extras and malformed/unsafe inventory rejected.
